in_hebrew.name: Owusu
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Born on a Friday
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Owusu הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Akan language of Ghana, Owusu translates to 'born on a Friday'. It is a common name in Ghanaian culture and is associated with good fortune and prosperity.

in_greek.name: Owusu
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Born on a Friday

in_latin.name: Owusu
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Born on a Friday
in_latin.long_meaning: Owusu est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Akan language of Ghana, Owusu translates to 'born on a Friday'. It is a common name in Ghanaian culture and is associated with good fortune and prosperity.
